decisions.question: R-LZ note: a pre-registered moving landing; each moving row is listed in the prereg with a ruling id that reads RULED (or an OWED id whose own lock lands in the same commit)
decisions.recommendation: CARD-mb18i-landing (~/Buildo-scratch/p2close/CARD-mb18i-landing.answered.md), O-i1 option 1. Drafted and panel-checked at ~/Buildo-scratch/mcbylaws/R-batch-as/drafts.md (Draft 1 v2). Rule text: a pre-registered moving landing. While increment 1 cannot be green, a commit may also land a `revert` round of increment 1 whose prereg lists each moving row, each `expected_moves[]` entry naming its authority in a `ruling` field: a register id that reads RULED with no OWED marker, or an OWED id whose own lock lands in the same commit (the exception R-KG gives arm C). The run must show exactly those moves, every other total equal, and floors held or up. Pins move only through the tool to the prereg totals (R-LI 124a:1053). This note is in force from the lane G check (MB-79 (x), lane G); until that check lands, this row's zero-move text governs. From then, the gate will refuse a move the prereg does not list and a listed move whose `ruling` is missing or not usable. The zero-move landing of this row is unchanged.
